key_highlights: ASX shed $90bn in a week on rate-rise fears and oil price surge, dragging miners and banks lower
AUD smashed as growth scare builds, amplifying import-cost and inflation pressures
Iron ore entering a 'bloodletting' phase, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX valuations
Oil prices explode as OPEC+ suppression fails; Australian fuel prices set to rise 30c/litre
RBA flagged rental inflation as a key concern, complicating the rate-cut path
ANZ.AX axed 3,500 jobs but structural transformation remains incomplete
Housing market bifurcating: high-end prices crash while affordable segment and first-home buyers surge
Mining cap-raise wave intensifies as Canaccord leads a 'dash for cash' across juniors
Gold weakens ('gold schmould'), reducing safe-haven bid into ASX gold names
Australia softens local gas supply rules, easing Asian energy-security fears and supporting Santos.AX

sectors.trend: Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; gold weak; but small-cap lithium, battery-tech and gold-silver explorers (PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka, Standard Lithium, Critical Resources, Kuniko, Gateway WA) show relative strength. Cap-raise activity surging.
sectors.implications: Large-cap miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) face margin pressure from falling iron ore. Juniors in battery metals and critical resources offer selective upside but carry dilution risk from cap raises.

sectors.trend: ANZ.AX post-3,500-job-cut transformation still maturing. Superannuation policy debate (One Nation 'sugar hit', early-access proposals) creates regulatory uncertainty. RBA rental-inflation focus may delay rate cuts, supporting NIMs but pressuring credit growth.
sectors.implications: Big Four (CBA.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX) benefit from higher-for-longer rates but face political risk on super reform. Watch for margin compression if RBA pivots.

sectors.trend: Oil surge on failed OPEC+ suppression; Australian fuel prices +30c. Australia softens gas supply rules, supporting Santos.AX and LNG exporters. US gasoline likely to lift August CPI.
sectors.implications: Santos.AX, Woodside.AX, Origin.AX benefit from gas policy easing. Higher fuel costs feed through to inflation, complicating RBA path. Consumer energy bills rising.

sectors.trend: No spring bounce in auctions; high-end property sees steepest falls; affordable segment resilient; first-home buyers surge. Women's clothing chain closes 177 stores. Business confidence weak.
sectors.implications: REITs (GP.AX, SPG.AX) face mixed demand. Homebuilders (MPL.AX, PNC.AX) may see volume support from first-home buyers. Consumer discretionary under pressure.

sectors.trend: ASX runners include Iondrive, Australasian, Aruma, Neurizon. HIVE appoints enterprise vet for AI cloud. OpenAI agent security breach raises cyber-risk awareness. Optus outage prompts welfare checks.
sectors.implications: Selective small-cap momentum in AI/tech. Cybersecurity and infrastructure resilience themes gaining relevance. Telco (TPG.AX, VHC.AX) reliability under scrutiny.

key_themes: Rate-rise fears vs. growth scare: RBA caught between rental inflation and slowing activity
Commodity divergence: oil up, iron ore down, gold weak – mixed for diversified miners
Housing bifurcation: luxury correction vs. affordable resilience; policy debate on supply and migration
Superannuation political risk: One Nation proposals and early-access debate threaten system stability
Mining capital markets stress: cap-raise wave signals cash burn across juniors
AUD weakness amplifying imported inflation and import-cost pressures

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA forced into rate hike or delayed cuts due to rental/fuel inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge rate sensitivity via short-duration bonds; favour fixed-rate income; monitor RBA statements closely

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price collapse hitting ASX 200 mining weights
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold, lithium, and critical-resource names

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AUD depreciation triggering imported inflation and capital outflows
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge AUD exposure; favour domestic-revenue companies; monitor AUD/USD 0.62 support

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Superannuation policy disruption from political populism
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify super exposure; monitor APRA and Treasury consultations; favour large-cap fund managers (HUB.AX, PPA.AX)
Avoid pre-announcement cap-raise names; favour cash-flow-positive juniors; set strict position limits

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market correction spilling into broader credit cycle
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor NAB/CBA credit growth data; favour banks with strong NIM buffers; watch mortgage arrears

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate from iron ore majors into critical resources and battery metals
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore bloodletting vs. structural demand for lithium, battery tech (Critical Resources), and gold-silver (Kuniko, Gateway WA)

opportunities.recommendation: Add energy exposure on gas policy easing and oil surge
opportunities.rationale: Australia softening gas supply rules supports Santos; oil price spike lifts upstream margins

opportunities.recommendation: Selective bank accumulation on rate-supportive NIMs
opportunities.rationale: Rental inflation keeps rates higher longer; ANZ restructuring nearing completion; NIMs supportive

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce large-cap iron ore exposure; hedge with gold or short-duration bonds
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore bloodletting and AUD weakness create dual headwinds for BHP/RIO/FMG

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim consumer discretionary and high-end REIT exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Housing correction at luxury end, weak auctions, business confidence deteriorating, clothing chain closures

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid pre-announcement mining cap raises; set stop-losses on small-caps
defensive_moves.rationale: Canaccord-led cap-raise wave signals dilution risk across juniors

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely to consolidate lower near-term as $90bn weekly loss digests. Oil-driven inflation and AUD weakness keep RBA on hold or hawkish. Miners and banks lead declines. Expect volatility around RBA commentary and US CPI data. Support near prior lows; resistance at pre-selloff levels.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if iron ore stabilises and RBA pivots to cuts by H2 2026. Housing correction at luxury end may moderate. Critical resources and energy offer structural upside. Superannuation policy risk remains a wildcard. GDP growth likely to moderate but avoid recession.
